tool_input.query:
SELECT c.id, c.code, c.name,
       SUM(COALESCE(s.enrollment_count,0)) AS total_enrollments,
       SUM(COALESCE(s.fail_count,0)) AS total_fails,
       CASE WHEN SUM(COALESCE(s.enrollment_count,0)) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE SUM(COALESCE(s.fail_count,0))::decimal / SUM(COALESCE(s.enrollment_count,0)) END AS fail_rate
FROM vw_section_stats s
JOIN courses c ON c.id = s.course_id
JOIN program_courses pc ON pc.course_id = c.id
JOIN programs p ON p.id = pc.program_id
WHERE p.name ILIKE '%Công nghệ thông tin%'
GROUP BY c.id, c.code, c.name
HAVING SUM(COALESCE(s.enrollment_count,0)) >= 5
ORDER BY fail_rate DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;
